'''Forbes Marshall''' is a multinational engineering company. It specializes in and manufactures steam engineering and control instrumentation products.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/forbes-marshall-plans-to-step-up-export-business/article6558007.ece |title=Forbes Marshall plans to step up export business |publisher=Business Line |access-date=14 November 2014}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Forbes Marshall Pvt Ltd |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/profile/company/8123746Z:IN |publisher=Bloomberg}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=HBR Case Study Alliance Management at Forbes Marshall|url=https://hbr.org/product/alliance-management-at-forbes-marshall/an/W11618-PDF-ENG}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://parsikhabar.net/individuals/darius-forbes-and-forbes-marshall-building-up-industry/3648/|title=Darius Forbes and Forbes Marshall: Building Up Industry|publisher=Business World|access-date=14 November 2014}}</ref>

== History ==

Forbes Marshall (now, Forbes Marshall Group) was originated as a trading company. It was set up by J N Marshall in 1926. It started supplying textile accessories to the textile industry in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. It started distribution of steam engineering products in 1946. The first factory for the manufacture of steam products was set up in Kasarwadi, Pune in 1958. In 1962 the company entered the control instrumentation business.

In the 1980s, the company established into two joint ventures - Forbes Marshall Arca (erstwhile Arca Controls), in partnership with Arca Regler, Germany and Krohne Marshall. a joint venture with Krohne Messtechnik, Germany.<ref name="km">{{cite news |title=Krohne Marshall expands Pune operations |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-ani/krohne-marshall-expands-pune-operations-116111700729_1.html |access-date=17 November 2016 |publisher=Business Standard}}</ref> In 2006, Krohne Marshall set up Asia's largest flowmeter calibration facility.<ref>{{cite news |title=Krohne Marshall firms up India expansion plans |url=https://www.dnaindia.com/business/report-krohne-marshall-firms-up-india-expansion-plans-1012019 |access-date=8 February 2006}}</ref> In the early 2000s Forbes Marshall entered into a joint venture with Codel International, UK. Codel is now a Forbes Marshall company.<ref>{{cite news |title=Forbes Marshal in JV with Codel Int'l |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/forbes-marshal-in-jv-with-codel-int-l-107100900031_1.html |access-date=20 January 2013 |publisher=Business Standard}}</ref> Forbes Vyncke, a joint venture company for manufacture of biomass boilers was formed with [[Vyncke]], Belgium in 2009.<ref>{{cite news |title=City-based Forbes Marshall ties up with Belgian firm Vyncke |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/cities/pune/citybased-forbes-marshall-ties-up-with-belgian-firm-vyncke// |access-date=14 March 2009 |publisher=The Indian Express}}</ref>

The company set up a new manufacturing plant at Chakan, Pune in 2013.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/forbes-marshall-vyncke-jv-sets-up-facility-at-chakan-113121201068_1.html|title=Forbes Marshall-Vyncke JV sets up facility at Chakan|date=2013-12-12|work=Business Standard India|access-date=2019-11-27}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Forbes Marshall opens new manufacturing facility in Chakan |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/indl-goods/svs/engineering/forbes-marshall-opens-new-manufacturing-facility-in-chakan/articleshow/27307690.cms?from=mdr |access-date=13 December 2013 |publisher=The Economic Times}}</ref>

== Manufacturing ==
The award-winning state-of-the-art manufacturing facility at Chakan<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/indl-goods/svs/engineering/forbes-marshall-opens-new-manufacturing-facility-in-chakan/articleshow/27307690.cms|title=Forbes Marshall opens new manufacturing facility in Chakan|last=Adarsh|first=Vasumita S.|date=2013-12-13|work=The Economic Times|access-date=2019-11-27}}</ref> near Pune, is spread over 50 acres of land and was designed by [[Christopher Charles Benninger|Christopher Charles Benninger Architects]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://architecturelive.in/forbes-marshall-green-field-industrial-campus-pune-by-christopher-charles-benninger-architects/|title=Forbes Marshall Green Field Industrial Campus, Pune, by Christopher Charles Benninger Architects|website=ArchitectureLive!|language=en-US|access-date=2019-11-27}}</ref> The campus has dedicated assembly and test rigs for hydro, seat leak and performance testing to ensure high quality systems.

Flow meters and control valves are manufactured at the Forbes Marshall facilities in Pimpri, Pune. The facility also boasts of a sophisticated calibration rig with the capability to calibrate flowmeters of up to 2000 mm. This NABL accredited rig is the second largest in Asia.<ref name=km/><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aninews.in/news/business/krohne-marshall-expands-pune-operations/|title=Krohne Marshall expands Pune operations|website=www.aninews.in|language=en|access-date=2019-11-27}}</ref>

== Industry academia connect ==
Forbes Marshall has partnered with various educational institutions for collaborative training programmes. They have also sponsored projects and training rigs to expose students to practical engineering. The company works closely with several engineering colleges in developing their curriculum and senior members of the company also serve as guest lecturers.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://punemirror.indiatimes.com/pune/cover-story/Forbes-Marshall-helps-COEP-students-go-full-steam-ahead-for-new-lab/articleshow/32254243.cms|title=Forbes Marshall helps COEP students go full steam ahead for new lab|date=November 24, 2010|first1=Arundhati|last1=Ranade|website=Pune Mirror|language=en|access-date=2019-11-27}}{{Dead link|date=November 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.businesswireindia.com/flow-level-lab-from-forbes-marshall-inaugurated-at-vit-35464.html|title=Forbes Marshall, Vishwakarma Institute of Technology, Flow and Level Lab, Mr. Kekoo Vacha, Mr. Sharad Rahudkar|website=www.businesswireindia.com|access-date=2019-11-27}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://daily.bhaskar.com/news/coep-boiler-room-gets-a-facelift-1584610.html|title=COEP boiler room gets a facelift|date=2010-11-25|website=dailybhaskar|language=en|access-date=2019-11-27}}{{dead link|date=May 2025|bot=medic}}{{cbignore|bot=medic}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://archive.indianexpress.com/news/students-join-hands-with-industry-set-up-steam-engg-lab/716844/|title=Students join hands with industry, set up steam engg lab – Indian Express|website=archive.indianexpress.com|access-date=2019-11-27}}</ref>

Every year Forbes Marshall conducts a three-day Teacher's Training Programme for faculty of Engineering Colleges.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.forbesmarshall.com/About/Training|title=Forbes Marshall Training Programmes|website=www.forbesmarshall.com|access-date=2019-11-27}}</ref>

In 2013, Forbes Marshall Forbes launched its Technology Centre at the [[Indian Institute of Technology Madras|IIT Madras]] Research Park.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://prfeed.in/2013/08/forbes-marshall-launches-its-technology-centre-at-the-iit-madras-research-park.html|title=Forbes Marshall Launches Its Technology Centre at the IIT Madras Research Park|date=2013-08-21|website=Press Release India|language=en-US|access-date=2019-11-27}}{{Dead link|date=November 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}</ref>

Forbes Marshall launched its Energy Efficiency Centre at [[Indian Institute of Technology Bombay|IIT Bombay]] in 2016.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.india.com/news/india/forbes-marshall-launches-energy-efficiency-centre-at-iit-bombay-1333884/|title=Forbes Marshall launches Energy Efficiency Centre at IIT Bombay|date=2016-07-15|website=India.com|language=en|access-date=2019-11-27}}</ref>

Forbes Marshall and [[University of Peradeniya]], Sri Lanka set up a Steam Engineering Centre.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.ft.lk/business/Value-delivery-at-its-best--25-years-of-Forbes-Marshall-in-Sri-Lanka-/34-647980|title=Value delivery at its best: 25 years of Forbes Marshall in Sri Lanka! {{!}} Daily FT|website=www.ft.lk|language=English|access-date=2019-11-27}}</ref>

== Corporate social responsibility ==
Forbes Marshall has been known for their social initiatives that broadly focuses on health, education and empowerment. The social initiatives of the organization have been mainly spread in the communities surrounding their factories. Forbes Marshall hosts a full-fledged activity center on its premises along with a play school. The activity centre hosts varied classes for school dropouts, underprivileged children, training for women's groups and meetings.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sakaltimes.com/pune/pcmc-forbes-marshall-host-children%E2%80%99s-film-fest-nov-23-25-27862|title=PCMC, Forbes Marshall to host children's film fest from Nov 23–25|date=2018-11-17|website=www.sakaltimes.com|language=en|access-date=2019-11-27}}</ref><ref>{{Citation|title=In conversation with Rati Forbes, Director, Forbes Marshall Ltd|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MxBfiqcqvXE|language=en|access-date=2019-11-27}}</ref>

=== Forbes Healthcare Foundation ===
The Shehernaz Medicare Centre, located on the Forbes Marshall Kasarwadi campus is a full-fledged 25 bed hospital run under the aegis of the Forbes Healthcare Foundation. Free medical aid is provided to the employees and communities from the surrounding areas.

=== Forbes Marshall Foundation ===
Forbes Marshall has set up a Foundation with the objective of supporting projects and communities, located outside of Pune, India. The focus is on supporting sustainable and collaborative projects and initiatives in the state of Maharashtra, with the objective of enhancing impact.
